integrity.known_results: The established maximum code size four is not claimed as new; only its attaining-code census and orbit classification are.
integrity.priority: A documented literature search supports the originality assessment but does not establish absolute priority.
integrity.reproducibility: Direct LCS, directed-triple masks, and independent labeled expansion give mutually agreeing exhaustive finite counts.

scientific_limitations: The exact census concerns six distinct symbols and minimum Ulam distance four; no extension to other blocklengths is proved.
The full 1999 Mathon–van Trung text was unavailable; possible overlap with any unpublished or unindexed directed-triple packing table remains unresolved.
The finite enumeration is fully reproducible from source but no external audit has occurred.
title: Fifty-seven symmetry classes of optimal six-symbol Ulam codes
